source.author: verg
source.text: Hinc quoque quingentos in se Mezentius armat, quos patre Benaco velatus harundine glauca Mincius infesta ducebat in aequora pinu.
source.text_original: Hinc quoque quingentos in se Mezentius armat, / quos patre Benaco velatus harundine glauca / Mincius infesta ducebat in aequora pinu.
source.text_english: From here too Mezentius arms five hundred men against him, whom Mincius, cloaked in bluish reeds from father Benacus, was leading out to the waters in an unfriendly pine as their guide.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: subita cur pulcher harundine crines velat Hylas?
reuse.text_original: subita cur pulcher harundine crines / velat Hylas?
reuse.text_english: Why does beautiful Hylas suddenly veil his hair with a reed?
